requests.request: Please put more emphasis on my Terraform and AKS (Kubernetes) work - put it in the summary and near the top of my current role. Those matter most for this job.
requests.evidence: The summary says “building Terraform networking modules, operating AKS (Kubernetes) clusters”; the current role opens with the AKS estate, Terraform networking modules and AKS operational responsibilities. The tool replied, “Your updated CV and cover letter are ready.”
requests.note: The emphasis is visible in the requested positions and introduces no unsupported numbers or responsibilities. The tool confirmed the update, although it did not explain the individual edits.

parsed.summary: Both documents are factual, consistent and responsive to the request to foreground Terraform and AKS. The strongest evidence is production Azure infrastructure, tested Terraform networking, AKS operations and measurable deployment improvements, with career breaks and responsibility boundaries handled honestly. The application remains less convincing on Terragrunt, TLS/certificate management, fleet-device integration and stakeholder-led system design, without fabricating those capabilities. The main presentation weakness is the unbalanced two-page CV; the letter is professional and targeted but could explain the transfer to fleet connectivity more persuasively.
